parameters.content:
### How it works
Helps newsletters, loyalty programs and events grow a contact list from a simple form. An n8n form collects the first name, last name, phone number and email address. The workflow creates the contact in Bi-way, or updates it when the phone number is already known so that no duplicate appears, then sends a welcome message by RCS with a button. Phones that cannot receive RCS get the fallback SMS of your account.

**Limits:** RCS only reaches French mobile operators. The phone number must be in international format, e.g. +33612345678: the form does not check it, and Bi-way refuses another format. Someone who sends the form again gets the welcome message again.

### Setup
1. Install the verified **Bi-way** community node (`n8n-nodes-biway-messenger`, [instructions](https://github.com/pocket-communication/n8n-nodes-biway-messenger#installation)). Tested with 0.3.0 on n8n 2.45.4 and n8n Cloud 3.1.0.
2. Create a **Bi-Way API** credential with an API key from Bi-way › Settings › Security.
3. RCS needs an agent launched by the French operators (check with RCS Agent › Get Status). Without one, set the Bi-way nodes to your SMS channel; buttons are left out.
4. Optional: pick a contact group in **Save the contact** › Options; without it, Bi-way uses your default group.
5. Add a consent field to the form if your privacy policy asks for one, and replace `https://www.example.com`.
6. Publish the workflow, then send the form with your own number.

### Customization
Change the fields in **Sign-up form**, the columns in **Save the contact** and the wording in **Send the welcome message**.

![Workflow overview](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pocket-communication/n8n-nodes-biway-messenger/main/examples/images/form-welcome-message-nodes.png#full-width)
